description: Ask to add an app to the person's own persistent phone (not the simulator). Returns a consent card: app name, publisher, the permissions it asks for, and approve_url and decline_url. Show the card to the person and tell them to open a link themselves: you cannot approve, and nothing is installed until they do. A card expires after 15 minutes. Fails with unknown_app, already_installed or unauthorized. Needs PN_ASSISTANT_TOKEN.
name: request_app_install
